name: Retention Reviews
description: The Monday retention review an agent writes from the records above: revenue at risk, every red account, every renewal coming up.

body.en: Read the `busa-customer-health` skill in this folder and follow it. Write the retention review for last Monday to Sunday from the accounts, signals and save plays: a one-line headline, ARR at risk and how it changed, every at-risk account with its cause and play, watch accounts renewing in the next 90 days, and what changed since last week. Save it as a draft.
body.zh-CN: 先阅读本文件夹里的 `busa-customer-health` Skill，按它的规则做。根据客户、信号和挽留动作，写上周一到周日的留存周报：一句话结论、有风险的年收入及变化、每个有流失风险客户的原因和挽留动作、未来 90 天内续费的关注客户、与上周相比的变化。保存为草稿。

label.en: What got better or worse since last week?
label.zh-CN: 和上周比哪些变好了、哪些变差了

body.en: Read the `busa-customer-health` skill in this folder and follow it. Compare the two latest reviews and the signals between them: which accounts changed light, how ARR at risk moved, and which save plays closed. Do not change anything.
body.zh-CN: 先阅读本文件夹里的 `busa-customer-health` Skill，按它的规则做。对比最近两份周报和期间的信号：哪些客户换了灯、有风险的年收入怎么变、哪些挽留动作完成了。不要修改任何记录。
